name: MAVOS-DD
description: Large-scale open-set benchmark for multilingual audio-video deepfake detection. It evaluates whether detectors can generalize to unseen fake-generation models and unseen languages across real and synthetic video content.
evaluation_method: classification metrics over open-set splits; typically AUC/accuracy/F1, with separate reporting on unseen-language and unseen-generator subsets
typical_sota_score: 60–95% (AUC/accuracy; performance varies substantially, with lower scores on unseen-generator and unseen-language splits)
notes: Over 250 hours of real and fake videos across eight languages; about 60% generated. Training/validation/test are arranged so only a subset of languages and generators is seen during training, making it an open-set benchmark. Exact question count is not applicable because it is a dataset benchmark. Citations reported: 4.
